title: This AI Agent Launches Hundreds of Meta Ads in Minutes
description:
We just built one of the most exciting internal tools our agency has ever used.
Instead of spending 30+ minutes manually trafficking ads, our AI agent reads creative assets directly from Figma, downloads everything automatically, generates on-brand copy, applies placement customization, and pushes ads into our Meta staging environment.
The result? Nearly two dozen ads launched in just a few minutes.
This is still a work in progress, but it's a glimpse into how AI agents will transform media buying, creative operations, and agency workflows.
In this video:
 ✅ Read creatives directly from Figma
 ✅ Generate ad copy automatically
 ✅ Customize placements at scale
 ✅ Push ads to Meta staging
 ✅ Launch dozens of ads in minutes
If you're interested in AI, media buying, performance marketing, and agency automation, subscribe for more content.
Comment "workflow" below if you'd like to see more behind-the-scenes breakdowns of our media buying systems.
#MetaAds #FacebookAds #AIAgents #MediaBuying #MarketingAutomation #PerformanceMarketing
transcript: I'm extremely excited about this. We just built the coolest tool for our agency to traffic hundreds of ads that are on brand with copy configured appropriately with placement customization, everything you need for a perfect execution flawlessly. Come along, let me show you how it works. So, our creative strategist just delivered a batch of creatives that speak to different ICPs and have different product lines. And to traffic these would take probably around 30 minutes. But now, I just want to give our agents instructions by just dropping in the URLs, the hyperlinks, telling it where to drive, which ads have to go to PDP, which ones have to go to homepage, and what the ICPs are for each. Then, I just click send. From here, we can see that it's opening the frame file and reading all of the assets. It's downloading all the images on my behalf. After downloading all of the images, it's now creating the batch of ads on my behalf. It automatically pushes it into our staging ground in which we can launch all the batches straight to Meta. And within 3 minutes, about two dozen ads are ready to launch. We choose the target ad set, and then we just hit launch. And within 3 minutes, we've launched all of our ads directly in Ads Manager, on-brand copy as well as placement customization for each one of our ads. We're still working out all of the kinks, but this is a new era for media buying. It cuts down time significantly, and I think it's going to change the way that agencies and brands operate. If you'd like to learn more about media buying workflows and how to be as efficient as possible as well as effective as possible, feel free to give us a follow along and comment workflow in the comments below. Thank you, and see you next time.
